protocol.hardware: Both policies are rebound to the candidate registered triple-serial-leg lineup.
protocol.scope: Same-hardware policy comparison; not native-opponent-lineup results and not evidence about unpublished competition models.
protocol.sample_scope: Fixed-seed development and validation comparisons; these are not an independent tournament win-rate estimate.

installed_compatibility.scope: Separate engine, SDK, projectile spread and chassis brakes; results are not pooled with the source-engine summary.

development.scope: Earlier candidate versions and development seeds; excluded from final-version results.

validation.opening_physics: All six serial-leg robots reach the deck by 15 seconds.
validation.return_physics: All six return to supply by 45 seconds in the staged congestion regression.
validation.tests_command: uv run python -m unittest -v tests.test_gpt61_max_2027 tests.test_gpt61_trident_2027 tests.test_gpt61_2027 tests.test_strategy_library tests.test_strategy_gallery tests.test_strategy_naming

reproduce: uv run python scripts/evaluate_2027.py examples/gpt61_sol_max_2027 examples/deepseek_flash_2027_anchor examples/dsv41_1017_pair examples/dsv41_1017_sentry examples/step5_2027_echo examples/gpt61_2027_trident --seeds 2801 --duration 420 --jobs 1 --output build/sol-max-recheck.json
